title: Fluted Glass Photo Card
description: Fluted glass shader (via @paper-design/shaders-react) — streaked, ribbed distortions over an image with five grid shapes (lines/linesIrregular/wave/zigzag/pattern) and five distortion shapes (prism/lens/contour/cascade/flat). Looks like looking through textured architectural glass.
